newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan flies to Gaza.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan flies to Gaza.

text.p: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan and Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti flew to Gaza on Monday for talks with Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat, officials said.
They said the Jordanians would brief Arafat on King Hussein's talks with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem on Sunday.

Netanyahu spoke briefly to Arafat during his meeting with King Hussein. It was their first conversation since the PLO cut contacts with Israel in protest over its settlement plans and limited troop withdrawal plans in the West Bank.
Arafat, enraged at Israel's plans to build a new Jewish settlement close to Arab East Jerusalem, had twice refused to receive Netanyahu envoys in the last 10 days.
